Find the area of $△ABC.$ Round your answer to two decimal places.

feedback.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13946476/assets/200dcd87827ae9683ba0ecb3b284509b31d32f9e0dc1b9736a260d2f7d71b0a0.png)

Rounded to **two decimal places**, the area of $△ABC$ is{{field-1}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}ac\operatorname{sin}⁡B,
$$

where $∠B$ is between the sides of lengths $a$ and $c.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}c & =AB=5, \\ a & =BC=5, \\ m∠B & ={60}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{60}^{∘}=0.866\,025,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 5\cdot 5\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{60}^{∘} \\  & =12.5\cdot (0.866\,025) \\  & ≈10.83,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to **two decimal places**.
